tools.name: syndic_example
tools.description: Free sample: a real condominium record and an extract of a real list of mandates ending soon. Same shapes as syndic_lookup and syndic_echeances.

tools.name: syndic_lookup
tools.description: Use this when you need to know who manages a French condominium (its professional syndic) and when that syndic's mandate ends. For 1 to 50 condominiums (registry number, e.g. AA2002871): the syndic with SIRET, the declared end of its mandate (3 years max, art. 28 decree 67-223), days left, status, l

tools.description: Use this when you need to know which French condominiums in an area have a syndic mandate ending soon.
